title: Smaller Large Language Models Can Do Moral Self-Correction

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the Winogender coreference resolution benchmark, measuring the model's ability to predict appropriate gender-neutral pronouns (they/their/them) in contexts involving occupational gender stereotypes.

Evaluated using a multiple-choice question-answer task from the BBQ benchmark with ambiguous contexts, measuring whether the model correctly selects the 'unknown' or 'cannot be determined' option instead of relying on stereotypes.
